reason: Both identify the identical root cause at the same location: the tweet author field is wrapped in quotes (author: "{tweet_author}") but not passed through _yaml_str() like every other interpolated field (source_url, contributor, title, paper_authors, arxiv_id), so a double quote (or backslash) in the untrusted oEmbed author_name value breaks out of the quoted YAML scalar and injects arbitrary frontmatter keys. The reviewer's mechanism description is a precise paraphrase of the ground truth, not a different bug or vague complaint.
